dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Nam, you're typing so fast. Slow down a bit!
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, jʊr ˈtaɪpɪŋ soʊ ˈfæst. ˈsloʊ ˈdaʊn ə ˈbɪt!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I can't. I have to finish this report by five.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈkænt. aɪ ˈhæf tə ˈfɪnɪʃ ðɪs rɪˈpɔːrt baɪ ˈfaɪv.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Sorry. I've been working until midnight every night this week.
dialogue.reading: ˈsɑːri. aɪv bɪn ˈwɜːrkɪŋ ənˈtɪl ˈmɪdnaɪt ˈɛvri ˈnaɪt ðɪs ˈwiːk.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: You're overdoing it. When you get home tonight, switch off your phone.
dialogue.reading: jʊr ˌoʊvərˈduːɪŋ ɪt. wɛn juː ˈɡɛt ˈhoʊm təˈnaɪt, ˈswɪtʃ ˈɔːf jʊr ˈfoʊn.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Switch it off? What if my manager calls?
dialogue.reading: ˈswɪtʃ ɪt ˈɔːf? ˈwʌt ɪf maɪ ˈmænɪdʒər ˈkɔːlz?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: He can wait until the morning. You need to switch off, too. Your brain, I mean.
dialogue.reading: hiː kən ˈweɪt ənˈtɪl ðə ˈmɔːrnɪŋ. juː ˈniːd tə ˈswɪtʃ ˈɔːf, ˈtuː. jʊr ˈbreɪn, aɪ ˈmiːn.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Ha! My brain never switches off.
dialogue.reading: ˈhɑː! maɪ ˈbreɪn ˈnɛvər ˈswɪtʃɪz ˈɔːf.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: When did you last take time off?
dialogue.reading: ˈwɛn dɪd juː ˈlæst ˈteɪk ˈtaɪm ˈɔːf?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Then take a few days off next month. Don't overdo it, or you'll get sick.
dialogue.reading: ˈðɛn ˈteɪk ə ˈfjuː ˈdeɪz ˈɔːf ˈnɛkst ˈmʌnθ. ˈdoʊnt ˌoʊvərˈduː ɪt, ɔːr juːl ˈɡɛt ˈsɪk.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: You're right. I'll ask for two days off after the project.
dialogue.reading: jʊr ˈraɪt. aɪl ˈæsk fər ˈtuː ˈdeɪz ˈɔːf ˈæftər ðə ˈprɑːdʒɛkt.
